mckinsey.name: McKinsey & Company · QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
mckinsey.description: Software engineer on the technology side of QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, building software for client engagements where technology is the means rather than the end. Same engineering work, at a larger scale and across a wider variety of problems.

mediaHero.name: Media Hero
mediaHero.description: Joined as one of the first three people and left with the company at around 90, with an engineering team that runs on its own and a product that held up through every growth turn. Built the data platform from the first lines of code: a Next.js + tRPC + Prisma platform delivered in 9 months, CI/CD and infrastructure with Terraform on GCP, a cohesive UI with Ant Design, shadcn and Tailwind, product analytics with PostHog. Made the first hires, set up the engineering processes, and launched the company's first marketing site on Webflow.
mediaHero.stack: Next.js, tRPC, Prisma, Terraform, GCP, PostHog

xp.name: XP Inc.
xp.description: Built tools that improved workflow reliability and centralized data across multiple systems and databases. Delivered a real‑time web dashboard for financial data, gathering direct analyst feedback to prioritize features that increased productivity and decision‑making confidence.

pipefy.name: Pipefy
pipefy.description: Graduated from the Young Guns Tech trainee program, rotating across teams to learn the product and customers. Shipped features such as Share Inbox, Form Hub, and Guest Portal. On the PLG team, improved conversion by enhancing usability and FTUE, running iterative A/B tests with design.
pipefy.stack: TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Ruby on Rails, Elixir

xpIntern.name: XP Asset Management
xpIntern.description: On the Project Squad, built a Django portal to monitor fund performance, integrated Power BI dashboards, and implemented automations that improved team efficiency. Helped manage and validate platform updates.

adp.name: Amigos da Poli
adp.description: Built the 2020 Project Notice site with Angular and launched a new brand website with a React/Gatsby CMS. The new site increased conversions and donations; during the Month of Giving, created a real‑time donations dashboard that gamified engagement and boosted participation.

poliJunior.name: Poli Júnior
poliJunior.description: Delivered custom systems for clients using Django, React, React Native, and Node.js. Introduced and trained the team on modern web technologies and software architecture practices. Co‑organized Workshop Integrativo, Latin America's largest recruitment fair; built a Django information system to digitize and centralize fair data and created a WhatsApp chatbot that increased conversions and traffic.
poliJunior.stack: Python, Django, Node.js, React, React Native

zoroscopo.name: Zoroscopo
